point_of_no_return.title: Archive before continuing
point_of_no_return.why: A late base-game transition closes ordinary Hideout cleanup until clear data or an earlier save.
point_of_no_return.detail: Complete the available checklist before accepting the transition.

levels.1: Use the native PC edition.
levels.2: Install the Windows release and every owned content pack.
levels.3: Use the Windows build with the All-In-One DLC bundle, or equivalent ownership of Repaint Your Heart, the Picaro Persona pack, and the Weapon Pack. Record the patch and installed-content list before creating the archive save.

levels.1: A separate title-menu scenario expands the archive.
levels.2: Confirm Repaint Your Heart appears in DLC Mode.
levels.3: Install the challenge scenario, launch DLC Mode once, and create its separate save. Its story missions, conversations, Reports, paint mechanics, and five challenge stages do not share ordinary progression with the base campaign.

levels.1: The complete PC route adds a separate summon set.
levels.2: Confirm thirteen additional Personas appear after the Velvet Room unlock.
levels.3: Install the Picaro Summoning Pack plus Raoul, advance until its entries become accessible, summon every included Persona once, and keep those rows separate from the 206-entry base compendium audit.

levels.1: A cosmetic weapon set arrives through progression.
levels.2: Confirm all ten Picaro weapons enter inventory at their intended unlock points.
levels.3: Install the Weapon Pack before the first mission. After every shop expansion, inspect all party inventories and record each newly delivered Picaro weapon; ten entries must be present by the end of the base route.

levels.1: Keep files before irreversible progress and restart.
levels.2: Rotate pre-mission, pre-transition, clear-data, and DLC slots.
levels.3: Reserve independent saves for the latest Hideout, the next unplayed mission, the state before the late transition, completed clear data, New Game Plus, and DLC Mode. Never overwrite the sole clear file when testing carryover.

levels.1: The tactical settings can be documented on separate branches.
levels.2: Complete an archive run on the intended high setting and record friendly-fire behavior.
levels.3: Choose the target difficulty before a mission, document its damage and friendly-fire rules, and preserve a branch before changing it. Use Replay for award cleanup instead of weakening the only proof file.

levels.1: Most ordinary stages hide three optional performance marks.
levels.2: Use Replay until every eligible stage shows all three awards.
levels.3: At each pre-battle screen, open the award panel, note its turn cap and no-knockout condition, then clear all three marks together or across replays. Boss-style stages without award rows are clear-only records.

levels.1: The restart carries selected archives but resets growth.
levels.2: Duplicate clear data before beginning New Game Plus.
levels.3: Start New Game Plus from a copied clear file. Verify the compendium, opened fusion recipes, money, equipment, Report entries, and play time; levels, GP, and skill selections restart and must be rebuilt.

save_backup.title: Keep a protected branch

save_backup.detail: Retain it until this section is fully audited.

point_of_no_return.title: Archive before continuing
point_of_no_return.why: New Game Plus restarts levels, GP, skills, missions, and quest availability.
point_of_no_return.detail: Complete the available checklist before accepting the transition.

levels.1: Finish every available battlefield.
levels.2: Clear every base mission and preserve clear data.
levels.3: Complete the base route, verify every stage result in Replay, and save clear data to a new slot before returning to cleanup.

levels.1: Replay ordinary stages with their panels open.
levels.2: Earn three stars on all 44 award-bearing stages.
levels.3: Open Replay, inspect each award-bearing stage, and continue until all three marks are filled on all forty-four eligible entries. Boss-style stages without panels require only their clear record.

levels.1: Finish the puzzle battles before the late transition.
levels.2: Complete all quests and claim their group fusion rewards.
levels.3: Clear all fifteen quests, claim each GP or skill reward, and verify Principality, Seth, Black Frost, Shiva, and Satanael fusion access.

levels.1: Clear every yellow Talk marker.
levels.2: Archive all thirty base Hideout conversations.
levels.3: Compare the Old tab with the thirty-entry ledger and view any remaining conversation fully so its GP is awarded.

levels.1: Replay late ordinary stages efficiently.
levels.2: Raise the base-route party to level 99.
levels.3: Use late Replay stages with complete awards and experience bonuses, rotate unfinished units, and continue until the party-level display reaches 99.

levels.1: Some masks wait for quests and New Game Plus.
levels.2: Register every base Persona and all twelve new-cycle fusions.
levels.3: Complete all quests, start New Game Plus, rebuild to level 96, fuse the twelve new-cycle entries and Satanael, then sort the compendium and confirm all 206 rows are filled.

levels.1: Growth resets even though archives carry.
levels.2: Finish a New Game Plus route from duplicated clear data.
levels.3: Verify carried compendium, recipes, money, equipment, Reports, and play time, then rebuild levels, GP, and skills while completing the tactical route again.

levels.1: Paint Mode uses its own save and progression.
levels.2: Clear all fourteen DLC story stages and seven conversations.
levels.3: Finish the separate paint scenario, view all seven Talk entries, and preserve its clear file. Reload the base clear data only after the DLC completion flag exists.

levels.1: New tests appear after the DLC scenario.
levels.2: Clear every DLC Challenge Stage condition.
levels.3: Open DLC Mode after its story clear and complete all five named Challenge Stages, verifying every clear stamp.

levels.1: The DLC clear modifies the following base cycle.
levels.2: Verify both additional units become selectable after the base party reforms.
levels.3: Complete Repaint Your Heart first, start a fresh base New Game Plus branch, advance until the party reforms, and confirm Crow and Violet are selectable in ordinary missions.

levels.2: Capture base, New Game Plus, and DLC completion menus.
